prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):

   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "new_photo_samples", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "upload_photos": {"hint": "Select clear, well-lit photos for optimal pet generation quality."}}
1: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Grid Showcase Redesign: Redesign the pet selection screen into a grid visual layout highlighting default preset pet companions clearly.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "grid", "headline": "Choose Your Companion", "replace": {"pet_choices": [{"role": "pet_choices", "type": "choice_cards", "label": "Preset Pets", "style": "playful"}]}}}

   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "split", "headline": "Sign In to Save Your Pet", "body": "Keep your pet data safe and synced across all your desktop sessions."}}
3: [adoption, incentive] Starter Accessory Reward Callout: Add an adoption certificate badge highlighting a bonus starter accessory given upon completing registration.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "text": "Bonus Starter Pet Accessory Included!", "style": "highlight"}]}}

   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "How Would You Like to Start?", "body": "Pick a ready-made pet companion instantly or create a custom pet from your photos."}}

   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "new_account_intro", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"], "sign_in": {"hint": "Signing in protects your pet progress across app updates and re-installs."}}
6: [home, new_flow] Desktop Spawn Waiting Mascot Animation Flow: Add a dedicated pet hatching sub-flow with an animated mascot on the waiting screen while desktop assets load.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_desktop_hatch", "home_intro"], "waiting": {"headline": "Preparing Your Pet's Desktop Home", "components": [{"type": "mascot", "asset": "asset:pet_hatching", "style": "playful"}]}}
7: [finish, hint] First Interaction Hotkey Callout: Display a prominent keybinding hint on the home intro screen detailing how to toggle and talk to the desktop pet.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Tip: Press Ctrl+Shift+P anytime to reveal, hide, or interact with your pet."}}
8: [adoption, layout] Adoption Certificate Compact Confirmation Layout: Switch the adoption certificate screen to a compact layout that reduces visual clutter around pet naming.
   config: {"adoption_certificate": {"layout": "compact", "headline": "Name Your New Pet", "body": "Give your companion a name to complete the adoption certificate."}}
9: [choose_path, layout] Story Screen Split Story Scroll Layout: Change the initial story screen layout to story_scroll for easier continuous reading before path selection.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "story_scroll", "headline": "Welcome to Desktop Pets"}}

verdicts.reason: Adds a sample photo screen within onboarding without violating any base rules.
Redesigns the pet selection layout while preserving its core function.
Updates sign-in screen layout while keeping its required job intact.
Onboarding copy mentions a bonus accessory, violating the rule against mentioning gifts or free extras.
Updates path selection copy while maintaining both adopt and create choices.
Adds an assurance screen before sign-in without skipping or removing required steps.
Adds a mascot animation sub-flow to the waiting sequence within onboarding.
Adds an interaction hint to home_intro screen within onboarding.
Changes adoption certificate layout while retaining its essential naming and certificate function.
Changes story screen layout while preserving pet introduction function.
